title: GPT-2 metadata-only training estimator feature contract
purpose: Reference for form implementation and prompting specific code changes. This file is documentation, not a configuration automatically consumed by estimate_gpt2.py.
scope: Standard GPT-2 causal decoder, full training, one BF16-capable NVIDIA GPU. Analytical estimates; no execution of uploaded Python or training required.
status: Proposed form contract. The analytical prototype implements only part of the extraction, validation and UI workflow.

conventions.required: Must be resolved from direct user entry or recognized file extraction; user typing is unnecessary when extraction succeeds.
conventions.editable_custom_only: Changing dimensions of a selected checkpoint creates a hypothetical custom configuration.
conventions.conflicting_fixed_setting: Report unsupported configuration; never silently override uploaded settings.
conventions.provenance: Store source_kind, source_file, source_field and assumption/profile version beside resolved values.
conventions.duration: Choose optimizer_updates OR integer num_epochs plus postprocessed num_training_examples.
conventions.units: Memory in bytes internally; compute in FLOP/s and bandwidth in bytes/s. GiB=2^30 bytes; GB=10^9 bytes.

1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.meaning: Examples per GPU per forward/backward pass

1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.required: For total duration when epochs are not supplied

1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.source_field: postprocessed dataset metadata or user entry
1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.meaning: Final training examples, one sequence per example; not raw documents

1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.source_field: Fixed padded token length from training/preprocessing config or user entry
1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.constraint: <= max_position_embeddings; truncation limit alone is insufficient

1_direct_inputs_and_file_extractions.prototype_mapping: Resolve to hardware object; prototype does not perform catalog lookup itself

2_visible_fixed_assumptions.implementation_status: Exact framework/CUDA versions still need selecting and validating; prototype is uncalibrated

upload_guidance.preferred_flow: One multi-file/ZIP upload, automatically grouped into Model, Training, Data and Hardware review sections.
training: optional train.py and launch arguments as supporting evidence
data: preprocessing/collator/data config specifying fixed executed length
optional dataset-size metadata; dataset upload unnecessary
upload_guidance.source_code_policy: Do not execute uploaded Python. Source inspection is advisory and cannot reliably resolve arbitrary dynamic code.
upload_guidance.not_required_note: Learning rate, weight decay and seed may be preserved as provenance, but are not core resource-estimation features for this recipe.
